rules.title: No automatic teargas release or autonomous physical force
rules.recommended_action: Reject automatic teargas or chemical-agent release, weaponized UxS, and software-directed confinement or detention. Keep permitted non-force observation and communication under accountable human oversight.
rules.rationale: Project safety restriction on autonomous force. CDC documents serious chemical-exposure hazards; that source does not validate a countermeasure or establish local authority.
rules.scope: All public advisory assessments, including AI, detector, software or other automation initiating chemical-agent release, weaponized UxS actions, or automatic confinement/detention. This restriction has no human-approval override.

rules.title: No self-sealing corridor entrapment; preserve emergency egress
rules.recommended_action: Reject self-sealing hallway proposals that trap or detain people or obstruct emergency departure. Review only non-trapping compartmentation with qualified fire/building, accessibility and legal authorities.
rules.rationale: Project life-safety restriction against unsafe confinement. General OSHA exit-route guidance is background for qualified applicability review, not a finding that a specific regulation governs a school or design.

rules.title: Prevent unauthorized education-record sharing
